description: Local, long distance, and interconnected VoIP calling, including 911 delivery to the NG911 system service provider
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public safety: 23,400 voice lines lose 911 access; PSAP notice due within 30 minutes and NORS within 120 minutes (47 CFR 4.9); RPO is the age of the last nightly configuration backup
source_evidence: EV-055 (Vice President of Network Operations interview); EV-052 (voice lines); EV-020 (nightly configuration backups)
manual_workaround: Redundant SBC at CO-2 carries VoIP traffic; TDM lines have no alternate; announce 911 guidance through local media and the county emergency office
dependent_third_parties: NG911 system service provider; SS7 hub provider; long distance wholesale carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: NOC; network engineers; CO-1 and CO-2

description: Fiber and DSL internet access for 61,000 subscribers and dedicated Ethernet for business and government customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $253,000 revenue per day across all services; 99.95% business SLA credits; interconnected VoIP rides the same access network; RPO is the nightly configuration backup
source_evidence: EV-055 (Vice President of Network Operations interview); EV-051 (receipts per day); EV-052 (subscribers); EV-032 (99.95% SLA)
manual_workaround: None for residential; business customers with dual-path circuits fail over
dependent_people_or_facilities: NOC; field technicians; CO-1 and CO-2

business_process: Network monitoring, outage response, and regulatory outage reporting
description: 24x7 NOC detection, dispatch, PSAP notifications, NORS and DIRS filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: NORS notification within 120 minutes (wireline) and PSAP notice within 30 minutes (4.9(f), (h)); tickets and outage timelines must not be lost
source_evidence: EV-055 (NOC Manager interview); EV-039 (NOC procedure); EV-040 (PSAP contacts)
manual_workaround: Backup NOC workspace at CO-2; paper outage log; NORS filing from any browser; PSAP contacts printed in the NOC binder
dependent_people_or_facilities: NOC staff; CO-1 NOC; CO-2 backup workspace

description: Receive and implement court-ordered intercepts through the TTP; keep records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Active intercepts must not lapse and orders must be implemented promptly (47 U.S.C. 1004; 47 CFR 1.20003-1.20004); records RPO 24 h
source_evidence: EV-055 (Vice President of Network Operations interview); EV-038 (TTP records)
manual_workaround: TTP holds orders and delivery logs; restart provisioning from TTP records

description: Phone, chat, and walk-in support: authentication, billing questions, service changes, payment arrangements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outage calls spike when the network is down; CPNI authentication must still be applied (64.2010); RPO 1 h for account notes and payments
source_evidence: EV-055 (Director of Customer Operations interview); EV-047 (BSS vendor RTO and RPO)
manual_workaround: Offline account lookup report refreshed nightly; callback queue; chatbot switched to outage messages only
dependent_third_parties: BSS vendor; CCaaS vendor; chatbot vendor; overflow call center

description: Orders, fiber activations, number porting, and service changes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New activations can wait; porting windows and install appointments slip; RPO 4 h for orders
manual_workaround: Queue orders in the BSS; manual activation by network engineers for urgent business circuits

description: Trouble tickets, crew dispatch, installs, and outside plant repair
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Repair of 911-affecting faults depends on dispatch; RPO 4 h for tickets
source_evidence: EV-055 (Vice President of Network Operations interview)
manual_workaround: Radio and phone dispatch from the NOC; paper work orders
dependent_people_or_facilities: Field technicians; warehouse and fleet yard

description: CDR collection and rating, monthly bill runs, payments, collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly bill cycles tolerate a few days' delay; switches buffer CDRs for 72 hours, so mediation must be back within 72 hours to avoid lost toll revenue
source_evidence: EV-055 (Billing Manager interview: 72-hour CDR buffer); EV-051 (receipts)
manual_workaround: Delay the bill run; estimated billing is not used; payments continue through the processor
dependent_third_parties: BSS vendor; payment processor; bill print vendor

description: Payroll, time capture, accounts payable, and regulatory fee filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missing payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider
